how: We read the website of every Atlanta wedding videographer listed on Lazo (94 listings, 69 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: branding and corporate video houses, photo booth rental companies, a Chattanooga-based team, and sites that were only a login page or a blank template. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Is audio from the vows and toasts recorded on lapel mics and a board feed, or just the camera?
Outdoor ceremonies here can get a late-afternoon storm; how do you cover a last-minute move indoors or under a tent?
How long until the highlight film and the full-length edit arrive, and are raw files included?

picks.name: Picture This Media
picks.blurb: Over 13 years making wedding films, with every package filmed in 4K. Picture This Media says it spends time with you in person discovering what you want rather than advocating what it thinks you should have, and client notes on the site name Arnitra by name.

picks.name: Catherine Vargas Films
picks.blurb: Catherine Vargas is a wedding filmmaker and creative director making fine art films for South Asian, Indian and Muslim weddings, with cinema collections built to cover the Mehndi through the Sangeet. Based in Peachtree City; collection pricing is on the site.

picks.name: John & Kym Creative Co
picks.blurb: A husband-and-wife team in Winder whose own story starts on Christmas Eve 1994, when John held a church door open for Kym's family, and who now film love stories. Packages come with add-on options, and the pitch is that everyone deserves to preserve their memories.

picks.name: ATL Video Studio
picks.blurb: AJ and a partner film around 35 weddings a year out of Kennesaw, which the site says keeps availability limited. Couples' notes on the site describe a responsive, detail-focused process from contract through the wedding day.

picks.name: 2KFILMS, LLC
picks.blurb: 2K Thomas founded 2KFILMS in 2008, and the husband-and-wife team now makes story-driven cinematic films and photography in Atlanta and North Georgia, with films from $2,400. The site frames the work as service rooted in faith and community.

picks.name: Wedding Film Pros
picks.blurb: A 20-year veteran wedding videography company whose background is DJing and record production with Billboard-charting music, a Stellar award nomination for a music video and film festival wins. Based in Lawrenceville, with an Investments page on the site.

picks.name: McIntosh Bros Weddings | Atlanta Wedding Videographer & Photography
picks.blurb: For over a decade McIntosh Bros Weddings has filmed and photographed hundreds of couples in Atlanta, with photo and video packages that can be bundled together and custom packaging available. The site leads with clients' own words about quick turnaround.

picks.name: HeartBrave Studios Video+Photo
picks.blurb: Married for 10 years and working together all of them, including 7 in the wedding industry, this Conyers couple does fine art wedding photography and videography with a refined style. One grew up near Atlanta, the other in Redding, California; they work Atlanta and worldwide.

picks.name: Fable Creature Video Production
picks.blurb: Fable Creature makes cinematic wedding films from Dallas, Georgia, and prints its packages: the Day Dreamer gives six hours of coverage with one videographer and is designed for smaller weddings and elopements.

picks.name: Wedding Wizard | Atlanta Wedding Videographer
picks.blurb: Kidd has over half a decade of filming experience and calls himself your personal paparazzi and hypeman, a self-described goofball who works to make couples comfortable on camera. Atlanta-based, filming across Georgia, with a Pricing page on the site.

picks.name: Bob's Eye View
picks.blurb: Robert and Amy's owner-operated, husband-and-wife team in Marietta has filmed more than 900 weddings across the Atlanta area over ten-plus years, from the getting-ready scenes to the send-off.

picks.name: 24/7 Digital Media Films
picks.blurb: An Atlanta and Acworth photography, videography and live streaming team that specializes in South Asian and multicultural weddings, with wedding collections from $5,500 and a Best of Zola 2024 mention. The same crew also shoots corporate work and multi-camera broadcasts.
